claims.statement: An oriented first-half middle state retains p,a,R,u,g,h,r,s,lambda with p/4<a<p/2, R=4a-p, u|a^2, R|u+a, u<a and the exact gcd normalization.
For j=hrlambda, Q=4j-1 and A=h lambda^2, p=RQ-(Q+1)^2/(4A), with QR=p+4hr^2, Qs=p lambda+r and Q+1<2AR.
For every prime p=1 mod 8 and every oriented middle state, 4p>=3t^2+6t-25 for t=min(R,Q); equivalently t<=4 floor(sqrt((p+7)/12))-1. Equality is attained at p=41.
claims.proof_locator: core.tex, A sharp hyperbola bound, first theorem

claims.statement: For p modulo 840 in {1,121,169,289,361,529}, 4p>=3t^2+14t-81 and t<=4 floor((sqrt(3p+73)-2)/6)-1; equality has the classified coordinates and occurs at p=1801.
Every oriented middle state at a hard prime belongs to exactly one of the direct and cofactor charts, and the displayed formulas give a complete inverse from the cofactor chart to the original state.
claims.proof_locator: core.tex, The complete disjoint two-chart atlas

claims.statement: The p=2521 cofactor state returns a valid original residual-55 state while the original residual-47 shell has neither channel occupied.
claims.proof_locator: core.tex, A smaller cofactor is not a smaller original shell

claims.statement: The cofactor-chart candidate count is at most K(p)(1+log K(p))^2; the direct-chart divisor count is the explicit finite sum in core.tex.
For every fixed B there are infinitely many hard primes having no E state with h<=B and no oriented M state with j<=B, although each constructed prime has an explicit endpoint E solution.
claims.proof_locator: core.tex, No fixed cutoff on the two original grades

claims.statement: The partial-factor order conditions with F|n-1 and F^2>n prove n prime by forcing F|d-1 for every prime divisor d of n.
Force at least one original E or M coefficient for every hard prime.

nonclaims: No proof or counterexample to the Erdos-Straus conjecture.
No assertion that either chart is occupied at every hard prime.
No assertion that the equality quadratic takes infinitely many prime values.
No identification of the cofactor chart with the original shell having residual Q.
No prime-independent grade cutoff; T7-C08 disproves that route.
No new overall computational verification range.
No Lean build, independent human review or historical-priority determination.
